text: This is not a defect. Just as with water, the three worlds have arisen from a single primal matter (Pradhana) due to differences in the substrates of opposing qualities; therefore, they are not of equal nature. The gods are endowed with happiness, humans with sorrow, and animals with delusion. It is evident that although originating from one primal matter, the transformation occurs like that of water, owing to the differences in the substrates of opposing qualities.
